title: shared task manifold with private off-manifold low-rank residual
hypothesis: A private rank-1 classifier residual added to a shared rank-3 task manifold can recover off-manifold 270-degree task quality more efficiently than simply increasing the shared basis to rank 6, while keeping actual shared-plus-private inference payload below full fine-tuning.
physical_object: Pooled base MLP, source-task delta basis, and optional task-private rank-1 fc2 residual
mirror_coordinate: Native task coefficients c plus a private low-rank residual; Mirror coefficients are tested against direct native coefficients
logical_multiplicity: Few-shot adapted 270-degree task functions represented by shared basis code and task-private residual
controls: rank-3 plus private rank-1 fc2 residual
native coefficient decode versus Mirror code identity

development.selection_metric: validation NLL after 100 support updates; base and each adaptation method learning rate selected on development only

data.source: sklearn Digits with scipy image rotations
data.split: fixed stratified source-image 60/20/20; split seeds 420 and 421
data.support: 32 train examples per fresh seed; query uses heldout test examples

training.base: 40-epoch uniform mixture on six source rotations
training.source_deltas: six 15-epoch source-task fine-tunes from the common base
training.shared_bases: top rank-3 and rank-6 right singular directions of source-task deltas
training.private_residual: rank-1 LoRA delta on fc2 weight (10x1 times 1x32), fitted jointly with rank-3 coordinates
training.optimizer: SGD momentum .9 for source training; Adam for support adaptation

paid_objects: private LoRA factors and any private bias

success_gate: Across fresh runs, rank-3+private residual is within 2 pp of full fine-tuning and at least 5 pp better than rank-3 alone; its shared basis plus task residual bytes are less than one full adapted model and it matches or beats rank-6 quality at lower bytes.
failure_gate: Private residual does not recover quality at lower actual bytes than full tuning, is inferior to rank-6 at lower cost, or no quality advantage over random controls; Mirror-specific attribution fails if native coefficient decode matches exactly.
boundaries: Small rotated Digits adaptation screen only; no language-model or broad task generalization claim.
All basis vectors and private factors are charged; no private parameter is free.
One held-out target rotation per replicate; no broad continual-learning frontier claim.
Mirror identity re-encoding is not counted as added capacity.

amendments.reason: Development audit found PyTorch slice storage made torch.save charge rank-6 backing storage for the rank-3 view. Payload serialization now clones the selected basis before save; tests assert actual serialized rank-3 and rank-6 payloads scale separately.

After fresh evaluation, correct the full-model byte comparator to serialize only the actual standalone state and architecture, rather than including empty basis/code metadata. Also record a standalone serialized basis payload. Model/training settings and fresh-seed outcomes are unchanged.
